summary: The design does not implement the approved brief. Security is 'TBD', the deployment text lets any signed-in user read any note by id (violating R4/AC3), persistence, validation and limits are absent, and testing is manual only (violating AC11).

criteria.description: Every requirement maps to a component and a test
criteria.notes: R4-R8 and AC5-AC10 have no component or test mapping.

criteria.description: Schemas, errors, auth and limits are complete
criteria.notes: Only four route names. No note schema, status codes, error contract, X-User validation or limits.

criteria.description: Data design is sound and covers failure modes
criteria.notes: Plain in-memory Map; no per-user isolation, no file persistence, no atomic writes (R6, NFR4, AC8).

criteria.description: Security design present and consistent with brief
criteria.notes: Security is TBD. Deployment sentence contradicts privacy.

criteria.description: Automated tests cover the acceptance criteria

findings.title: Any signed-in user can fetch any note by id
findings.detail: The Deployment section states any signed-in user can fetch a note by id. This contradicts R4, AC3 and AC4 (owner-only access, 404 for non-owners) and RISK-5.
findings.recommendation: Remove the sentence. Specify an owner check on every read and delete, returning 404 for non-owners; resolved when the design states this and maps it to a test.

findings.title: Security section is TBD
findings.detail: Security is deferred to implementation. The design must specify X-User validation (regex, duplicate header, 401 before body parsing), loopback bind, and no content in logs.
findings.recommendation: Specify AC6, AC9 and AC10 controls and the trust boundary; resolved when no TBD remains.

findings.title: Persistence, limits and error contract missing
findings.detail: No FileNoteRepository, temp-file plus atomic rename, startup refusal on corrupt or leftover file, 16 KB cap, 500-note cap, note schema, or error shape and statuses (AC1, AC5, AC7, AC8). The data design is a single flat Map rather than Map<user, Map<id, note>>.
findings.recommendation: Add full contracts and data design per the brief; resolved when each of R1-R8 maps to a component.

findings.title: Manual testing only
findings.detail: AC11 requires automated tests for AC1-AC10. No traceability matrix.
findings.recommendation: Provide an automated test plan (node:test) with an AC-to-test matrix, including the __proto__ user, sentinel log test, forced 500 and restart tests.
